subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift, benchmark window & proposed terms
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@northfield-warehouse.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: sam.keller@northfield-warehouse.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — capacity uplift and benchmark window

Hi Rishi / Avery,

Thanks again for the Q2 check-in. We finished our internal renewal discussion and are evaluating a switch to another provider that claims a ~30% cost reduction at scale. Before we make any decisions, we need a short benchmark window so we can validate throughput + inference latency under our spike patterns (20k concurrent lightweight requests, 2k long-context streams).

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood run a 7–10 day live benchmark using our traffic profile? We can share sanitized telemetry (attached sample) and can loop in CloudBench to run side-by-side.
- If Redwood can hit the latency/throughput thresholds, what concession on term/price or capacity guarantees can we expect for a renewal (we're considering a 36mo commitment if economics align)?
- What would a canary fallback look like if early results drift?

Attached a slice of our telemetry and the goals we care about. Sam, loop in anyone else on infra.

Best,
Priya Desai
Head of Platform Engineering
Northfield Warehouse Solutions

Attachments: northfield-throughput-telemetry.csv
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@northfield-warehouse.com>
Cc: avery_johnson@redwood.com, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift and benchmark window

Priya — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the telemetry. Short answers up front: yes on a controlled 7–10 day benchmark; yes on producing a tail-latency and throughput report; and yes, we can put a tailored capacity SLA / term concession on the table if the benchmarks validate our runtime.

Next steps I propose:
1) We schedule a kickoff call today or tomorrow to align on exact traffic replay and success criteria (p95, p99 thresholds, cold-start budget).
2) Redwood runs the benchmark in Dedicated-ephemeral capacity with prefix caching enabled; we’ll invite CloudBench (Ben) to run a side-by-side test.
3) If results meet the agreed criteria, we deliver a proposed term sheet (36mo optional, with step-down pricing tied to committed RPU) and a mutual action plan for rollout.

I’m looping Maya and Avery to sort capacity / pricing specifics and Monica for legal/terms coordination.

Available: 1:30–3:30pm PT today.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift and benchmark window

Quick internal note before the kickoff:

- Capacity: we can spin up a Dedicated-ephemeral pool sized to mimic 30k concurrent lightweight tokens if we shard across 3 nodes with the new batching schedule. Need to confirm GPU class (A100p vs H100i) — Avery, suggest H100i for latency headroom.
- Pricing/term levers: propose a two-path offer: (A) 36mo commitment with stepped unit pricing and 12% rebate tied to throughput milestones, or (B) 24mo + optional 12mo extension with a smaller rebate but larger upfront capacity credit.
- Legal: Monica, we'll need a short SLA addendum covering queueing thresholds, fallback routing, and a trial rollback clause.

Attaching a draft mutual action plan and a short checklist for the benchmark. I left placeholders for p95/p99 targets.

M

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-NW.xlsx
From: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@northfield-warehouse.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, Ben Howard <ben.howard@cloudbench.io>
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2028 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift and benchmark window

Priya / Sam — great to meet you virtually earlier. Recap and concrete proposal from infra/ops side: we can run a 7-day live replay using your anonymized traces. High-level plan:

- Environment: Redwood Dedicated-ephemeral (H100i), isolated tenant, KV prefix caching enabled, autoscale turned off to keep steady-state.
- Measurement: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, memory/GC events, and cost per 1M tokens. We’ll provide daily dashboards and a final consolidated report.
- Fallback: during the trial we’ll keep a warm fallback routing to our Hosted pool; if p99 latency degrades >25% vs baseline for 2 checkpoints, routing will failover to Hosted and we’ll pause the test.
- Deliverables: daily CSV telemetry, a final benchmark report, and a proposed term-sheet if targets are met.

Proposed term sheet (summary):
- Option A: 36 months, committed RPU + 12% rebate at 6/12/18 months on meeting throughput milestones; capacity SLA: 99.5% uptime for provisioned nodes.
- Option B: 24 months + 12mo extension opt-in, smaller rebate (7%) but $50k capacity credit applied in month 1.

Monica will coordinate contract redlines; Rishi to follow up on commercial flexibility.

Attachments referenced in thread: proposed-term-sheet-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Avery
Director, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@northfield-warehouse.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: sam.keller@northfield-warehouse.com, Ben Howard <ben.howard@cloudbench.io>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2028 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift and benchmark window

Thanks — the plan looks actionable and we appreciate the flexibility. A few quick items before we greenlight: 

- Ben (CloudBench) to confirm side-by-side schedule; he prefers to run an independent agent for the first 48 hours.
- Can you make the SLA addendum include a temporary credit if the benchmark fails to meet agreed p99 by >20%? We’d like a 'good faith' credit tied to the benchmark outcome.
- We need the final term-sheet and MAP by Monday EOD so procurement can run it through legal before the July 15 renewal cutoff.

If Redwood can include a one-time migration assistance credit (engineer-days) in Option A, we’ll prioritize Redwood in the procurement review. Sam and I will confirm dates once Ben sends availability.

Best,
Priya
Head of Platform Engineering
Northfield Warehouse Solutions
